notes: One coordinated city action on three streets is retained as a pending candidate, not counted as above threshold. Police action and arrest counts are separate from turnout. open_questions: Total crowd size across the three streets; whether simultaneous sites formed one coordinated assembly; independent reporting; exact route and sequence; other response fields.
